lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Seed treatment with Azotobacter & PSB biofertilizer + Thiram @ 2g/kg seed.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Use certified hybrids (e.g. Pusa HM 4, HQPM 1, Bio 9681).

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 2. खेत की तैयारी एवं मेड़ बनाना
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: FYM @ 10 t/ha + full P2O5, full K2O, Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha, and 1/3rd N basal.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for soil grubs and cutworms.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Ensure excellent field drainage; maize cannot tolerate waterlogging even for 6 hours.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Maintain soil moisture at 4-5 cm depth.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Place basal fertilizer 5 cm away from seed furrow.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Sow on ridges at 60x20 cm spacing.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Light irrigation if topsoil dries out.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout central whorls for Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) pinholes and sawdust-like frass.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Thin out extra seedlings at 12-15 DAS to keep 1 healthy plant per hill.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Crucial irrigation at knee-high stage (30-35 DAS).
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: 1st Top-dressing of 1/3rd Nitrogen (Urea) along with earthing-up.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Intensive scouting for Fall Armyworm (FAW) in the leaf whorl and Stem Borer (Chilo partellus).
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Apply whorl application of bio-agents (Metarhizium anisopliae) or neem formulation if FAW is detected.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 6. नर मंजरी (Tassel) व भुट्टे के बाल (Silk) निकलना
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Most sensitive critical irrigation stage; drought at silking causes blank cobs.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: 2nd Top-dressing of remaining 1/3rd Nitrogen before tasseling.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Maydis leaf blight and Banded leaf & sheath blight (BLSB).
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Never let crop experience water stress during silking.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 7. दाना भराव (दूधिया से ठोस दाना अवस्था)
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Irrigate to support grain expansion and cob filling.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Optional 0:0:50 foliar spray @ 1% for cob grain weight.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Corn earworm and cob rot fungi.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Ensure field drainage during monsoon downpours.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 8. परिपक्वता (दाने के आधार पर ब्लैक लेयर बनना)
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for cob droop and husk drying.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Black layer at the grain tip indicates complete translocation of carbohydrates.

lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: In-situ shredding of green maize stalks for soil organic carbon.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Inspect harvested cobs for Aspergillus flavus mold.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Harvest cobs when outer husks turn papery dry and grains are hard.

lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Maize weevil (Sitophilus zeamais) and grain moisture.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Dry grains to <= 12% moisture to prevent aflatoxin contamination.
